subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2023 · Fmge Mini Test 19

questions.stem: A 22-year-old woman presents to the emergency department with a 3-day history of dark urine and abdominal distension. On examination, she has an icterus but normal mental status. Laboratory findings include a hematocrit of 26%, reticulocyte count of 5%, platelets at 130,000, ALP of 30 IU/L, ALT of 110 IU/L, AST of 220 IU/L, total bilirubin of 13 mg/dL, negative HBsAg, and a negative urine drug screen. An abdominal ultrasound shows a nodular liver and an enlarged spleen. What is the most likely clinical diagnosis for this patient?
